text:
Elaine (CSM): Quick kickoff for Marina Logistics onboarding. Goals: connect their service to Redwood hosted inference, enable SSO (SAML), forward generation audit logs to their Splunk, and run a 30-day pilot with a 5k/day token cap. Need stakeholders, a tight timeline, and success criteria.
Tom (Solutions Eng): I can own the integration guide + test harness. Suggest discovery week (5bd), integration (7bd), then pilot. We should validate latency at expected load.
Priya (Onboard PM): Ill build a milestone tracker. For owners: who is Marinas IAM and who manages Splunk ingestion?
Marta (Marina IT): Marta here. IAM lead is Vivek, Splunk managed by Ops (Anya joins ops). We can commit resources for the integration but need clear pins.
Vivek (Marina IAM): FYI we use Okta and prefer SP-initiated SAML. Ill need metadata and a test account.
Raj (Security): Important: Marina processes limited PHI. Before prod we need SOC2 self-attestation, dataflow diagram showing PHI boundary, and confirmation of encryption-at-rest keys. Ill send the checklist.
Zoe (Success Ops): Ill prepare enablement pack: API quickstart, sample prompts, acceptance suite, and a runbook for pilot health checks.
Elaine (CSM): Draft success criteria: 1) SAML SSO working with test user, 2) Generation audit events appear in Marina Splunk index, 3) Integration test suite >=95% on acceptance prompts, 4) Pilot 95th percentile latency <350ms, 5) No P0 for 7 continuous days. Any other must-haves?
Tom (Solutions Eng): Add: signed-off output stability checks for critical prompt set and an integration smoke curl example:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"sanity check"}'
```
Priya (Onboard PM): Proposed workshop: Tue 10:00 PT or Wed 14:00 PT. Ill book 60m and capture action items live.
Marta (Marina IT): Tue 10:00 PT works for us. Vivek and Anya will join.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Marina Logistics  Onboarding Workshop" Tue 10:00-11:00 PT. Attendees: Elaine, Tom, Priya, Raj, Marta, Vivek, Anya.
Elaine (CSM): Risks: if SOC2 / SSO delays push beyond 45 days we should treat as a renewal risk and escalate to AMs. Action items: Tom -> integration guide draft (3 business days), Raj -> SOC2 checklist (48h), Priya -> milestone tracker + invites (done), Zoe -> enablement pack (EOD).
Tom (Solutions Eng): Ill upload playbook and initial test harness repo link in this thread by EOD.
Raj (Security): Checklist sent to Marta + Vivek. Please attach dataflow diagram when possible.
Marta (Marina IT): Will share IAM metadata and Splunk ingest details after the workshop.
Elaine (CSM): Thanks everyone. Ill run weekly pilot health check calls and capture feedback; if pilot goes well well involve Renewals mid-pilot to discuss terms. :rocket:
